title: Samples per Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $\varepsilon,\delta\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\varepsilon\leq\tfrac12$ and $0<\delta\leq\tfrac12$. The number of samples per coefficient is the Fourier-estimator sample count at the family’s coefficient accuracy for $\varepsilon$ and its confidence allocation for total failure parameter $\delta$.
caveat: The accuracy, confidence-allocation, and sample-count functions are not defined in the supplied definitions, so their exact values cannot be stated.
